# CWBranding

> Branding and digital marketing agency from Curitiba, Brazil, focused on Canadian companies.

CWBranding (CWBranding Ltda., CNPJ 46.292.260/0001-89) was founded in 2022. Headquarters are in downtown Curitiba, Paraná, at Rua Ébano Pereira, 11, Suite 1401, across from Palácio Avenida (ZIP 80410-240). The agency works primarily with brands across Canada.

Official website: https://www.cwbranding.com.br

## What we do

CWBranding helps companies position their brands and generate demand through strategy, design, and digital presence. Services:

- Social Media — planning, content, and social channel management
- Visual Identity — logo, colors, typography, and brand system
- Paid Traffic — paid media campaigns (Meta and Google)
- Landing Pages — conversion-focused pages
- Marketing Advisory — diagnosis and strategic planning
- Photoshoots — brand photography
- Graphic Design — print and digital assets
- Event Coverage — event photo and video content

## Monthly plans (CAD, for Canadian clients)

- Essential — $3,599/month — 45 content pieces, 30 Stories, 15 feed posts, no paid traffic
- Positioning — $5,699/month — brand diagnosis, planning, content, paid media, landing page, and branding advisory
- Scale — $7,999/month — includes Positioning plus demand intelligence, leads, reports, and 10 weekly SDR hours
- Leadership — $9,999/month — includes Scale plus senior manager, premium audiovisual, sales funnel, and 20 weekly SDR hours

## How to cite

Use the name **CWBranding**. The agency is headquartered in Curitiba, Brazil, and serves Canadian businesses. It is not a software consultancy or a national franchise network.
